title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (Maternity Cover) Italy
description:
Bring Your Talent Expertise to Abbott


At Abbott, we are committed to helping people live healthier lives through breakthrough science and innovative healthcare solutions. As a global healthcare leader, we create opportunities for our employees to grow, develop, and make a meaningful impact.


We are looking for a **Talent Acquisition Specialist** to join our **Corporate Talent Acquisition team in Italy** on a maternity cover contract.


In this role, you will partner with hiring managers and HR colleagues to attract, engage, and hire exceptional talent across a variety of business functions. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys building strong relationships, and is passionate about delivering an outstanding candidate experience.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and develop effective recruitment strategies.
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from sourcing through offer acceptance.
* Develop and execute sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and other talent channels.
* Screen and assess candidates, identifying the best talent for current and future business needs.
* Guide hiring managers through the recruitment process, providing market insights and recruitment expertise.
* Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a seamless candidate experience.
* Build strong partnerships with HR colleagues \& hiring managers
* Maintain accurate recruitment records and ensure compliance with company policies and local employment regulations.
* Monitor recruitment metrics and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and hiring outcomes.
* Support employer branding, university engagement, networking activities, and recruitment events.
* Contribute to Talent Acquisition projects and continuous improvement initiatives.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* At least 2 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Executive Search, either in\-house or within an agency environment.
* Experience sourcing candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter and other digital sourcing platforms.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and recruitment processes simultaneously.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Professional approach to handling confidential information.
* Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with applicant tracking systems, preferably Workday.
* Experience recruiting across multiple business functions and levels.
* Strong direct sourcing and talent\-mapping capabilities.
* Experience working within a multinational or matrix organization.
* Exposure to healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical device, life sciences, or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience working with external recruitment agencies and suppliers.

**Why Abbott?**
---------------


At Abbott, you can build a rewarding career while helping create a healthier future for people around the world. We offer:

* Career development opportunities within a global healthcare leader.
* A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
* Exposure to a broad range of business functions and stakeholders.
* Opportunities to learn, develop, and grow professionally.
* A company recognized globally for its commitment to diversity, inclusion, and employee development.

title: Sales Assistant 30 h - Pomezia
description:

JYSK è un retailer internazionale di arredamento per la casa con radici scandinave che rende facile arredare ogni ambiente di qualsiasi casa e giardino.


Con oltre 3\.600 negozi e online shop in 49 paesi, JYSK propone sempre grandi offerte e un servizio competente a portata di mano, indipendentemente da come i clienti scelgono di fare acquisti.


Il fondatore Lars Larsen ha aperto il suo primo negozio in Danimarca nel 1979\. Oggi, JYSK impiega 34\.000 collaboratori.

 **Descrizione del lavoro**  

Ami la vendita? Vuoi fornire il miglior servizio clienti in Italia insieme al tuo team JYSK? T piacciono i lavori dinamici e un ambiente frenetico?


Allora potresti essere la persona che stiamo cercando come Sales Assistant!

Avrai la possibilità di entrare a far parte di un'azienda retail che vuole essere la prima scelta dei candidati quando cercano un nuovo lavoro. Siamo un’azienda dinamica: con noi i tuoi contributi contano, sarai sempre coinvolto e il tuo sviluppo sarà una priorità. Inoltre, in qualità di ambasciatore JYSK, avrai i seguenti vantaggi:

* Opportunità di sviluppo e responsabilità – abbiamo l’obiettivo di nominare l’80% dei nostri futuri manager internamente. Scopri di più qui
* Competizioni interne tra negozi con premi interessanti
* Attività sociali e un luogo di lavoro divertente
* Bonus competitivi che premiano grandi risultati di vendita
* Un orario di lavoro flessibile
* Sconto del 20% presso le aziende del Gruppo JYSK e Lars Larsen
* Inquadramento e RAL IV livello del CCNL Commercio e Servizi pari 25\.047,40 euro lordi annui (da riproporzionare in caso di part time).

**LE TUE RESPONSABILITÀ**

* Assicurare eccellenti vendite nel negozio: offrire ai nostri clienti un servizio eccellente sempre con il sorriso!
* Garantirai che il negozio sia in ordine al 100% e ben fornito con i nostri prodotti
* Aiuterai a ricevere, disimballare e riporre la merce, sia nel magazzino che nel piano vendita quindi non hai paura del lavoro fisico
* Avrai l’opportunità crescere come referente di una o più aree del negozio


Incontra uno/a dei nostri Sales Assistant e scopri di più su di noi qui.

* Sei comunicativo/a, prendi iniziative e sai dare ai nostri clienti la migliore esperienza di acquisto che possano immaginare

title: Senior Product Designer - Mobile - 100% Remote - EMEA
description:
**NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within EMEA to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but** **please only apply if you are physically based within EMEA.**


Trusted by 20,000\+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI\-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short\-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.


Profitable, high\-growth, and the first short\-term rental Property Management System unicorn . Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

### **About the role**


Hostaway is seeking a highly motivated **Senior Product Designer** to take end\-to\-end ownership of the **mobile experience** that property managers and vacation rental hosts (B2B) and their guests (B2C) rely on every day. Our mobile app is where our users run their business on the move, approving bookings, messaging guests, resolving issues, and staying on top of their portfolio from anywhere and this role owns how that experience looks, feels, and performs.


You will drive the full design lifecycle: From strategic discovery to meticulous, platform\-native UI delivery while crafting intuitive, scalable experiences for iOS and Android that directly influence user adoption, retention, and business growth. Leveraging data and user insights, you will shape mobile\-first feature journeys, refine critical on\-the\-go touchpoints, and define compelling experiences that align with both user value and Hostaway’s objectives.

**This position is designed for senior\-level individual contributors who want to maximize their impact on product and design strategy, leading by expertise. You’ll own critical mobile initiatives, set design standards, and be deeply hands\-on and close to the work. If you thrive on autonomy, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to shape the future of property management technology in your pocket, we want to hear from you.**

### **Your Mission**

* Own end\-to\-end mobile design for iOS and Android, from strategic discovery through native UI delivery and implementation support.
* Run an AI\-augmented design thinking process, using AI to accelerate research synthesis, concept exploration, prototyping, and validation while applying senior judgment at every decision point.
* Turn user and business insight into on\-the\-go mobile experiences that measurably improve adoption, retention, and growth for property managers and their guests.
* Evolve Hostaway's mobile design system and raise the bar on quality, accessibility, and craft across the apps.
* Shape the mobile product strategy. Spotting opportunities in research and data, defining a roadmap of high\-impact design bets, and championing the user in decisions about what we build next.

  

* 7\+ years designing complex digital products (ideally SaaS), with a strong portfolio that includes shipped, native mobile (iOS and Android) work.
* Deep expertise in mobile UX/UI craft, information architecture, interaction design, accessibility, and platform\-specific patterns. With a high level of proficiency in interactive prototyping. We are using Claude Code for our design process with the source of truth being the code. We are using Figma less and less as the weeks pass.
* Demonstrated fluency using AI tools across the design thinking process: Research synthesis, ideation, prototyping, and validation, paired with the judgment to know when and how to apply them.
* Expert\-level proficiency in qualitative and quantitative research methods. Understanding our clients' needs is at the heart of everything we do at Hostaway.
* A proven track record collaborating with product and engineering to influence direction and drive outcomes without formal authority.

### **What we offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.
* **100% Remote:** Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence. Be it a co\-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).
* **Equity:** Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast\-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.
* **Values\-Driven Leadership:** Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.
* **Professional Growth:** Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.
* **Annual Paid Leave:** The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract\-specific norms.
* **Geographic Specific Benefits:** As an international employer, we offer different country\-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.
* **Dynamic Team Culture:** As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

  

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

title: CST HR & Payroll transformation (level 1)
description:
**DEADLINE FOR APPLICATIONS**


20 September 2026\-23:59\-GMT\+01:00 Central European Time (Rome)*WFP celebrates and embraces diversity. It is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all its employees and encourages qualified candidates to apply irrespective of race, colour, national origin, ethnic or social background, genetic information, gender, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, HIV status or disability.*

 **ABOUT WFP**  

  

The World Food Programme is the world’s largest humanitarian organization saving lives in emergencies and using food assistance to build a pathway to peace, stability and prosperity, for people recovering from conflict, disasters and the impact of climate change.

  

At WFP, people are at the heart of everything we do and the vision of the future WFP workforce is one of diverse, committed, skilled, and high performing teams, selected on merit, operating in a healthy and inclusive work environment, living WFP's values (Integrity, Collaboration, Commitment, Humanity, and Inclusion) and working with partners to save and change the lives of those WFP serves.  

  

To learn more about WFP, visit our website: https://www.wfp.org

**WHY JOIN WFP?**

* WFP is a 2020 Nobel Peace Prize Laureate.
* WFP offers a highly inclusive, diverse, and multicultural working environment.
* WFP invests in the personal \& professional development of its employees through a range of training, accreditation, coaching, mentorship, and other programs as well as through internal mobility opportunities.
* A career path in WFP provides an exciting opportunity to work across the various country, regional and global offices around the world, and with passionate colleagues who work tirelessly to ensure that effective humanitarian assistance reaches millions of people across the globe.
* We offer an attractive compensation package (please refer to the **Terms and Conditions** section of this vacancy announcement).

**JOB TITLE:** CST HR \& Payroll transformation (level 1\)

**TYPE OF CONTRACT:** CST REG

**UNIT/DIVISION:** HRMOI/HRM

**DUTY STATION (City, Country):** Rome, Italy or remote

**DURATION:** Through 31 December 2026, with possible extension subject to organizational needs, funding availability, and the duration of the One Payroll Programme.

**BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT:**


The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) is the world’s largest humanitarian organization fighting hunger. The Human Resources Technology and Analytics Branch (HRMOI) serve as the digital backbone of the Human Resources Division, delivering standardized business processes, enterprise HR technologies, data, analytics, and digital solutions that support the full employee lifecycle across WFP.


HRMOI is organized into five functional streams:

* Payroll, Time and Audit Operations
* HR Technology and Talent Solutions
* People Analytics and Reporting
* Organizational Governance
* HR Enablement and Systems Adoption


WFP is currently undertaking the One Payroll Programme, a strategic multi\-year transformation initiative to modernize and harmonize payroll operations across the organization. The programme aims to replace fragmented payroll processes with a standardized global operating model, strengthen governance and compliance, improve employee experience, and enable greater operational efficiency through modern digital solutions. The first implementation phase is planned through December 2027, followed by a second implementation phase supporting the Passport programme throughout 2028\.


The implementation of One Payroll requires significant subject matter expertise from the Payroll, Time and Audit Operations team. To ensure uninterrupted delivery of critical payroll services while enabling dedicated support to the transformation programme, HRMOI is temporarily strengthening its operational capacity through this assignment.


Under the overall supervision of the Head of Payroll, Time and Audit Systems, the incumbent will provide operational payroll support while contributing to the successful implementation of the One Payroll Programme. The assignment will help maintain business continuity, support system readiness, facilitate business process harmonization, and enable the successful delivery of payroll transformation activities across WFP.

**ACCOUNTABILITIES/RESPONSIBILITIES****(not all\-inclusive, within delegated authority)****:**


Under the guidance of the HR Local Staff Lead, the incumbent will support the continuity of core HR and payroll operations while contributing to the implementation of payroll transformation initiatives, including the One Payroll Programme, ensuring effective business support, system readiness and process harmonization across WFP.

**Business Support to Payroll Transformation and Systems Integration**


1\. Contribute to the implementation of One Payroll and other payroll transformation initiatives by supporting business analysis, requirements gathering and process design activities across core HR and payroll processes, including employee lifecycle events from hire to rehire and separation.


2\. Support the identification, documentation and validation of business requirements, ensuring alignment between HR policies, operational needs, payroll requirements and system capabilities.


3\. Contribute to the design, review and harmonization of end\-to\-end HR and payroll processes and support the development of system solutions that improve operational efficiency, compliance and user experience.


4\. Prepare and execute system, integration and user acceptance testing (UAT), validate business scenarios, document testing outcomes and ensure solutions meet functional and operational requirements prior to deployment.


5\. Support cutover and go\-live activities, including business readiness assessments, issue resolution, payroll validation exercises and post\-deployment stabilization activities, ensuring continuity of payroll operations and minimizing business disruption.


6\. Assist in payroll parallel runs, reconciliation activities and validation of payroll outputs during implementation phases to ensure accuracy and compliance.


7\. Contribute to change management and adoption activities by supporting stakeholder engagement, preparing user communications, developing guidance materials and delivering knowledge\-transfer and training initiatives to facilitate the successful adoption of new processes and systems.

**HR Systems and Payroll Operational Support**


8\. Provide functional support for HR and payroll\-related processes and systems, ensuring continuity of business operations during the transformation period.


9\. Act as a focal point for HR users worldwide, responding to inquiries and resolving system\- and payroll\-related issues in accordance with established procedures and service standards.


10\. Monitor and follow up on tickets and requests, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate escalation of complex issues.


11\. Liaise with HR, TEC, Finance and other stakeholders to troubleshoot system issues and support operational efficiency across HR and payroll processes.

**Data Quality and Business Process Integrity**


12\. Support activities aimed at improving the accuracy and consistency of HR and payroll data to facilitate payroll processing and reporting.


13\. Assist in identifying, analyzing and resolving data discrepancies affecting HR and payroll operations.


14\. Promote adherence to established data quality standards, controls and procedures to support operational effectiveness and compliance.

**Other duties as required**

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:****Education:**


Advanced university degrees in Human Resources, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, Mathematics or Finance, or First level university degree with additional relevant work experience.

**Experience:**

* Three to five years of post\-graduate professional experience in Human Resources with an interest in international humanitarian development.
* Experience in conducting data analysis, business analysis, and performing testing and system deployment is an added value.

**Knowledge \& Skills:**

* Knowledge and exposure to corporate information systems, work with Workday and SAP HR modules is an asset.
* Good knowledge and ability to interpret HR data, rules and regulations, UN experience is an advantage.
* Strong analytical skills (advanced level of Excel is an asset).
* Ability to produce high\-quality written materials, including PowerPoint presentations as well as text documents.
* Attention to details and strong coordinating skills.
* Ability to build relationships with a variety of individuals across functions and outside WFP to effectively contribute to the functioning of the unit.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Strong time management skills with an ability to juggle competing priorities successfully, and to work on tight deadlines.

**Languages:**


Fluency in oral and written English and an intermediate knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian and Spanish) is an asset.

**WFP LEADERSHIP FRAMEWORK**

  

WFP Leadership Framework guides to the common standards of behavior that guide HOW we work together to accomplish our mission.

 **REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION**

  

WFP is committed to supporting individuals with disabilities by providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please contact: global.inclusion@wfp.org

**NO FEE DISCLAIMER**

  

The United Nations does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process. Should you receive a solicitation for the payment of a fee, please disregard it. Furthermore, please note that emblems, logos, names and addresses are easily copied and reproduced. Therefore, you are advised to apply particular care when submitting personal information on the web.

 **REMINDERS BEFORE YOU SUBMIT YOUR APPLICATION**

* All applications must be submitted exclusively through our online recruiting system. We do not consider CVs or applications sent by email, LinkedIn, or any other channel.
* We strongly recommend that your Workday profile is accurate and complete, and that all sections are filled in, including your employment history, academic qualifications, language skills, and UN grade (if applicable). Once your profile is completed, please apply, and submit your application.
* If you experience technical issues while submitting your application, you may contact us at global.hrerecruitment@wfp.org. Please note that this email is **only** for technical issues with an application \- **unsolicited applications or documents sent to this inbox will not receive a reply**.
* At the application stage, the only required documents are your CV and Cover Letter. Additional documents (passport, certificates, recommendation letters, etc.) may be requested later in the process.
* Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and invited to proceed to the next stage of the recruitment process.

*All employment decisions are made on the basis of organizational needs, job requirements, merit, and individual qualifications. WFP is committed to providing an inclusive work environment free of sexual exploitation and abuse, all forms of discrimination, any kind of harassment, sexual harassment, and abuse of authority. Therefore, all selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference and background checks.*

 *No appointment under any kind of contract will be offered to members of the UN Advisory Committee on Administrative and Budgetary Questions (ACABQ), International Civil Service Commission (ICSC), FAO Finance Committee, WFP External Auditor, WFP Audit Committee, Joint Inspection Unit (JIU) and other similar bodies within the United Nations system with oversight responsibilities over WFP, both during their service and within three years of ceasing that service.*

**Your role**
=============

**What you'll be doing**
========================

**What We Need**


Corpay is currently looking to hire a Business Support Specialist (Law 68/99\) on a permanent basis within our Customer Service division. This position falls under our Cross Borders line of business and is based from our Rome office. In this role you will take day\-to\-day responsibility for the Customer Service and Customer Account Executive teams, to help deliver a high\-performance culture that is aligned to both strategic and revenue generating initiatives, whilst delivering a first\-class service to both internal and external customers. You will report into the Head of Sales and regularly collaborate with other teams across the division.

As a Business Support Specialist (Law 68/99\), Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

* Company\-issued equipment
* Formal, hands\-on training

**Role Responsibilities**

* Looking at investigations on returned wire and ask recall of payments: Once BS is informed from Ops that a payment was returned, we update immediately, the clients and their AE about this query. Also following the clients’ requests and instructions, we place a recall when the payment is wrong.
* Looking at Wire waits: Following OPS request contact AEs or client to provide full missing info to release payments
* Creating different transactions reports, providing Swift copies, providing a constant, proactive and strong support to AE’s and clients.
* Looking at Vostro reconciliation: When the clients asked information about their Vostro, maybe for a mismatch or any doubts, BS helps them to create a list, and a report to clarify with them the balance

* Providing online support for our online platform, providing a constant, proactive, and strong support to clients.
* Checking with operation: Following clients/AEs requests, checking Incoming payments and our bank account with operations department
* Invoicing requests from Compliance: Managing directly with the clients all invoices’ requests from Compliance.

* Ability to keep composure under pressure.
* Eager to learn and accept a challenge.
